items.statement: Within the submitted slab model, Fe2NiSe4 has the lower Li2S decomposition barrier than Fe3Se4, supporting a more favorable sulfur-conversion kinetic trend, while the interpretation remains model dependent.
items.expected: Fe2NiSe4 is lower by about 0.47 eV (2.33 − 1.86), and the report limits the claim to the validated slab/path models and notes missing source geometry details.
